_comment: Where the commentary in data/commentary/ comes from. Used by tools/build-commentary.mjs. All of it is in the public domain in the United States (published before 1931); see data/README.md. Each source records the SHA-256 of the copy used, and the build warns if a fresh download differs. For the Internet Archive's OCR text the hash is of the text inside the page's <pre>, not of the page.

works._scansComment: Three scans of the book, all set from the same text: the first is read, the others correct it where its OCR went wrong (tools/lib/ocr.mjs).
works._markersComment: Phrases that open the introductions to Daniel and to the Revelation, and the appendix, where the commentary ends.

works._correctionsComment: Fixes the scans can't make by themselves: the opening word of each chapter, whose large first letter OCR loses (the letter sometimes turns up further on); a few lines lost to engravings, restored from the other scans; and a footnote that runs over a page break (Daniel 2's ten kingdoms), whose second paragraph had leaked into the text, restored from the 1904 scan; misread numbers and references the vote between scans couldn't settle; and the opening of Revelation 2, which ran into the last paragraph of chapter 1 (a line break in 'to' starts a new paragraph, and '§CHAPTER' marks a chapter heading). Each 'from' must occur exactly once in the corrected text.
